title: Cross-sectional 12-month momentum across gold, silver, WTI and SPX, long top 1, short bottom 1, monthly
source: Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen (2013), Value and Momentum Everywhere, Journal of Finance 68(3)
why: Paper finds momentum in commodities (P3-P1 Sharpe about 0.53, 1972-2011) and in country index futures (0.73), ranking each market on its past 12-month return. This spec takes the four of our symbols that map to those classes (metals, oil, US equity index) as one basket, holding the top 1 long and bottom 1 short for 21 days. Deviation: the paper skips the last month (12-1); the engine has no skip, so the lookback is the plain 252-day return. Four symbols is far fewer than the paper's universe, so this is a narrow test.
